MECHANISM: Intermediate local-context refinement

HYPOTHESIS: A 384-token local-attention window will lower val_bpb below 0.984467 by capturing more useful context than 256 tokens while avoiding the throughput cost of 512-token windows.

INTENDED_EDIT: Increase the six local layers’ attention window from 256 to 384 tokens while retaining full-context attention at layers 4 and 8.

EVIDENCE: Reducing local windows to 128 tokens regressed, showing context capacity matters, while 512 tokens reached 0.984862 but processed only 503.6M tokens; testing the midpoint probes whether moderate added context can improve quality without paying the full 512-token throughput cost.
